difficulty_reason: The proof uses standard toric and dimer-model prerequisites, then performs a non-routine class-group argument from semi-steady summand dynamics. It analyzes nonadjacent zigzag intersections in an isoradial quadrangular dimer, tracks perfect-matching valuations through divisorial ideals, and derives an infinite translate contradiction. This source-local construction and contradiction are substantially beyond routine doctoral qualification exercises.
